title: Invite, change roles, remove
caption: PF-20, PF-21. Owners manage every role; admins manage agents, finance and viewers.

steps.title: Invite
steps.body: E-mail address and role (agent preselected), **Send the invitation**.
steps.expect: Listed under "Pending invitations"; `tenant_invitations` row `pending`, 7-day `expires_at`; Mailpit: "<inviter> invited you to <OTA> on Velexis".

steps.title: Seat limit
steps.body: Invite until the plan's `limits.staffSeats` is reached.
steps.expect: "Your plan includes N team seats, and N are taken by members and pending invitations."

steps.title: Change a role
steps.body: Pick another role in the member's row, **Change role**. Granting owner asks for a step-up.
steps.expect: "<name> is now Finance."; `tenant_memberships.role` and `version` change; `vx:invalidate` membership.

steps.title: Last owner
steps.body: As the only owner, try to leave or demote yourself.

steps.title: Remove
steps.expect: "The member was removed from the team."; `tenant_memberships.status = 'removed'` (row kept); the person loses the OTA admin within 60 s.

steps.title: Resend and revoke
steps.body: **Send again** and **Revoke** on a pending invitation.
steps.expect: Resend: new token and 7 more days, the old link stops working. Revoke: `status = 'revoked'`.
